none: PAS NLM-96774E: Roman Coin: Tetrarchic Nummus of Licinius
contea di ritrovamento: Norfolk (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IM[--]NVS PF AVG ; R/ [GE]NIO [POP ROM]

Copper alloy coin. Tetrarchic nummus, possibly of Licinius (308-324), Trier mint Genio Pop Rom issue of 308-317. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IM[--]NVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing left holding patera and cornucopiae; letter ?N in left field. Reverse inscription: [GE]NIO [POP ROM]. In exergue: PTR. Diameter: 23.8mm, Weight: 3.51gms, die axis: 6
